name: 袋装独立包装蜜桔详情款
description: 橙底圆标徽章加单字页签图卡，袋装独立小份的皮薄多汁蜜桔详情套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: solid vivid orange field #F5A21B alternating with pale warm cream #FBF0DE; rounded white #FFFFFF content cards floating on the orange field; light pine wood for hero shots and dark walnut wood #46301F for detail card shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm top or top-left key with gentle fill, 4800-5200K, soft contact shadows, dewy natural highlights on the glossy peel, no harsh speculars and no plastic look
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale pine wood table, dark walnut wood table #46301F, matte ceramic plates and bowls, warm brown clay teapot, pale linen cloth
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in warm charcoal #3A2E24 on cream and #FFFFFF on orange; section headers always centered inside solid orange rounded pills; no serif, no calligraphy, no handwritten display faces
styleLock.iconSystem: thin circular outline badges stroked in #F5A21B on white cards with one short label inside each circle, plus single-character square orange photo tabs at the corner of photo cards
styleLock.presentationRules: stable fruit scale and placement across the set; whole-fruit and cut-fruit states repeated consistently; pale green #4C7A3A citrus leaves as recurring garnish; product always resting on a surface with a contact shadow
noDrift: no calligraphy or brush display type
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm citrus detail-page ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of solid vivid orange field #F5A21B, pale warm cream #FBF0DE, warm charcoal text #3A2E24 and one fresh leaf green accent #4C7A3A; warm tone throughout; soft warm top or top-left key light with gentle fill, 4800-5200K, soft contact shadows and dewy natural highlights on the glossy peel with no plastic look; modern geometric sans-serif headlines, with section headers centered inside solid orange rounded pills; consistent rounded white content cards floating on the orange field, thin circular orange outline badges and single-character orange square photo tabs; clean fresh-fruit food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable fruit scale and placement with pale green #4C7A3A citrus leaves as recurring garnish; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no calligraphy or brush display type, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking fruit texture.
